assumptions: A second-step node touching several first-step neighbours is attached to the first drawn (not overflowed) neighbour in projection edge order; a node reachable only through another second-step node (possible in a truncated projection) is attached through that node and placed on its side.
A group caption counts every node of that kind in the column, including those collapsed into '+N more'.
The legend lists node kinds of every node in the projection, including hidden ones, as AC4 says 'present in the projection'.

behavior_changes.description: Change nodes get a double 3 px border in addition to the --warn tint, so spec and change (both tag-shaped) differ by more than colour; the plan named only the tint.
alternatives: Plain tag with only the --warn tint, as the plan worded it (spec and change then differ by colour alone)

behavior_changes.description: The caption counts are root-adjacent relationships per direction (edge.to === root / edge.from === root), matching how NodeDetailsPanel counts in AC7, not distinct neighbour nodes; a neighbour with edges both ways counts on both sides while it is drawn only on the outgoing side.
alternatives: Count distinct neighbour nodes per drawn column

behavior_changes.description: Caption and legend are HTML rows above and below the canvas inside the component's bordered box, not floated over the canvas, so they never cover node labels; this costs roughly two text lines of graph height.
alternatives: Absolutely positioned overlays on top of the canvas

behavior_changes.description: Geometry tuned from the plan's starting numbers so a depth-1 layout fits 440 px at zoom 0.8: node width at most 128 px (plan about 132), root at most 168 px (plan up to 180), column gap 40 px (plan about 44); long labels are therefore shortened a little earlier.
alternatives: Plan numbers 132/180/44, which do not fit 440 px at zoom 0.8 with 16 px padding

behavior_changes.description: Nodes with no edge to the root, a first-step node or an attached second-step node (only possible in a truncated projection) are not drawn; edges to nodes hidden in a '+N more' entry are not drawn either.
alternatives: Draw unattached nodes in the outgoing outer column
Draw edges to the '+N more' entry

notes: Cytoscape cannot mount under happy-dom ('Could not create canvas of type 2d', probed). RelationshipGraph therefore takes an optional `createCytoscape` factory prop that only the DOM test passes (a headless cytoscape); the app always uses core cytoscape. The exported contract otherwise matches plan.md exactly (projection, busy?, onSelect, onShowHidden?), plus exported RelationshipGraphProps and CytoscapeFactory types. A one-off probe with styleEnabled headless cytoscape (deleted afterwards, then kept as a real test) confirmed the stylesheet parses without warnings; it caught `font-weight: 650`, which cytoscape rejects, now 600. Token resolution reads the host's computed custom properties with a fallback to the root element (happy-dom does not inherit custom properties). TDD order: the layout tests were run red (module missing) before graphLayout.ts was written; the component was written before its DOM test, so that test was not observed red.
